notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, IAO, Mobilization Points and All Wrapped Up; these count toward the 60. No single starting Effect is named (the Effects come from Prepared Defenses); the strategy suggests starting There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement instead of All Wrapped Up against Sac decks.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), the only Dark Coruscant system before the Coruscant set; 'Coruscant Imperial City' and 'Coruscant Docking Bay' the Dark Special Edition sites Coruscant: Imperial City and Coruscant: Docking Bay; the Cloud City sites are the Dark pages (Downtown Plaza and Incinerator: the '(Dark)' pages).
Posted 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order (the 2001 Effect; the Secret Plans combo is Coruscant).
Posted 'Boba Fett w/ Booya Blaster' dested the Enhanced Premiere Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (the only 'Boba Fett With' card in 2001).

Posted 'IG-88 w/ Riot Control Gear' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-LOM w/ Tear Gas' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (the only Enhanced Premiere 4-LOM); 'Dengar w/ Blaster Carbine' Dengar With Blaster Carbine.

Posted 'ZiMH' and 'BiHT' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter and Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookie' Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee; 'There is No Try & Oppresive Enforcement' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement.
Prince Xizor is posted twice (once starting, once under Characters); the strategy explains the second copy.
Disarmed and Vibro-Ax dested the Dark pages Disarmed (Dark) and Vibro-Ax (Dark).
